summary: This gorgeous 2 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with free pool and beach access.

description.Space:
This gorgeous 2 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The 2 bedroom apartment comes with an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 2 full ensuite bathrooms and a living room  , not to mention a beautiful balcony that enjoys views of the pool and beach.  

It also features a 55 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & families. 

The styling is made with a elegant and chic taste to ensure guests have a wonderful and relaxing experience. 


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.

If you are traveling for business, do not book this place.

We requested an invoice from the property for over a week and spent many hours writing emails, making phone calls, and trying to resolve the issue. Unfortunately, the company managing the property refused to issue an invoice.

As a result, we asked them to cancel our reservation free of charge, since it had been paid for with company funds and we require an invoice for accounting purposes. They refused that request as well.

I do not believe this is a legally operating business.

In addition, they asked us approximately five times to send copies of our passports, even though we had provided them immediately after booking. The check-in instructions were confusing, and the location provided was incorrect. We had great difficulty finding the apartment.

The apartment itself is spacious and attractive, but it was not properly cleaned. There was hair in the bathroom and dust throughout the property.

During the night, we were badly bitten by something, and I suspect there may have been bed bugs in the bed.

The apartment is located on the third floor, which was not mentioned in the listing. There is no elevator.

Overall, booking this property was a mistake and caused us a great deal of stress, inconvenience, and unnecessary problems.
Don’t let the taxi get inside
